column1: # The math vocabulary (plan P1-22; design T8 MathDict): one row per spelling,
# font-independent. tools/mathdict.py reads it with the pinned UCD and MathML
# Core files and generates engine/gen/math_dict.h, engine/src/math/atom.h and
#   name: the spelling (a word, an operator key, AA..ZZ); a negation is the
#         `!` rule (plan P3-24: `!` before a relation), never a row
#   cp: the code point (0: a text operator, set in letters)
#   class: TeX atom class; flags: large limits textop fence (a symmetric
#         delimiter: one alone in a group is its middle, plan P3-24)
#   negation: the UCD precomposed negation (cp + U+0338), or - ; a row whose
#         code point the UCD does not negate may name one (| → ∤, ‖ → ∦)
#   alias_of: the row that owns this code point, or -
#   tex: the TeX spellings, space-separated (converters only, plan P3-24);
#         - = the name itself for an alphabetic name (\alpha), else none
#   default_for_cp: y = the row a bare code point takes its class from
#   class_source: mathml (as MathML Core derives it) or override
